errors.text_span: three different alignment methods—Squared Exponential, Truth, and LLAMA-2-chat-7B
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the data series. The legend shows four series: 'Squared-Exponential', 'Tanh', 'ELU', and 'LLaMA-2-chat-7B'. The description incorrectly lists 'Truth' instead of 'Tanh' and omits 'ELU' entirely.
The description completely omits the 'ELU' data series, which is represented by a solid light purple line with circular markers in the plot.
The 'Squared Exponential' line rises to a value visibly above the 55 mark on the y-axis, reaching approximately 56.
The legend in the plot identifies this data series as 'Tanh', not 'Truth'.
The line corresponding to the 'Tanh' method is solid, not dashed.
The line for 'LLaMA-2-chat-7B' is a dash-dot line, not a dotted line.
The line for 'LLaMA-2-chat-7B' does not have any markers.
The horizontal line for 'LLaMA-2-chat-7B' is positioned at an accuracy value below the 45 tick mark, at approximately 43, not 46.
